What was NEVER BUILT: there are NO VERBS (the envelope carries an opaque body, no dispatch); NO MENU (a device publishes no list of what it accepts); NO DELIVERY PATH AT ALL (post() writes a row and stops — shim.deliver() has zero callers outside proofs and no device anywhere defines receive); NO SYNC (reply_to is an orphan field with no correlation, no wait, no timeout); and shim.deliver silently returns None on a missing handler (a Law 7 breach in the delivery path). The bus has ONE producer in the whole tree (cairn/base/shim.py:122) and ZERO consumers — every other device talks AROUND it. COST OF THE QUIET RECORD: Akien read 'PROVEN', took the bus as existing, and directed months of work onto things standing on top of it — his words, 'if i'd known we didn't actually HAVE a bus yet, we wouldn't have been on the things we've been on.' A record of truth may be permanent and loud; this one was permanent and quiet. NOTE ALSO: proofs/test_bus.py is scoped to the substrate, so it stays green forever on a bus nobody can use — not hollow, but partial and not saying so. Completion is cast as CairnCommons/tickets/bus-completion.json (children a-f). ORDERING RULED BY AKIEN 2026-07-25: after the ground loop and the db, the bus comes before everything else.
